book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: تلات سنين يا واطسون.
sentences.en: Holmes said: three years, Watson.

sentences.ar: سنتين بالتبت، والتقيت بالدلاي لاما، وكتبت عن الرحلة باسم نرويجي.
sentences.en: Two years in Tibet, where I met the Dalai Lama, and wrote of the journey under a Norwegian name.
And passed through Persia, Mecca, Khartoum.

sentences.ar: وشهور بفرنسا، بمختبر، بأبحاث على الفحم.
sentences.en: And months in France, in a laboratory, researching coal-tar.
I said: and I?
Why did you not write to me?
He said: because you cannot lie.

sentences.ar: ولو عرفت، كان بيبين على وجهك، وكانوا عرفوا.
sentences.en: And had you known, it would have shown on your face, and they would have known.

sentences.ar: وأخوي مايكروفت بس كان يعرف، لأني بحاجة مصاري.
sentences.en: And only my brother Mycroft knew, because I needed money.

sentences.ar: وأوضتي بايكر ستريت، هو اللي حافظ عليها زي ما هي.
sentences.en: And my rooms in Baker Street, he kept them as they were.

sentences.ar: قال: وقبل أسبوع، قريت عن رونالد أدير.
sentences.en: He said: and a week ago, I read of Ronald Adair.
And I knew the time had come.
I said: how?
He said: the three who knew me.

sentences.ar: واحد مات، وواحد بالسجن، وواحد لسا حر.
sentences.en: One is dead, one in prison, and one still free.
The most dangerous man in London after Moriarty.
And his right hand.
Colonel Sebastian Moran.

sentences.ar: ضابط، وصياد نمور بالهند، وأحسن رامي بالجيش.
sentences.en: An officer, a tiger hunter in India, the best shot in the army.

sentences.ar: وهو اللي رمى الحجر من فوق الشلال.
sentences.en: And he is the one who threw the stone from above the falls.
And he is the one who killed Ronald Adair.

sentences.ar: قلت: بس الباب مقفول، والشباك عالي، وما حدا سمع طخة.
sentences.en: I said: but the door was locked, the window high, and no one heard a shot.
Holmes said: an air-gun.
Made by a blind German mechanic for Moriarty.

sentences.ar: ما إلها صوت، وبتطخ رصاص مسدس.
sentences.en: Soundless, and firing revolver bullets.
Across the street, window to window.
I said: and why Adair?

sentences.ar: قال: كانوا يلعبوا ورق سوا، وموران بيغش، وأدير اكتشف.
sentences.en: He said: they played cards together, Moran cheated, and Adair found out.

sentences.ar: وقال له: رجع المصاري، وإلا بحكي.
sentences.en: And told him: return the money, or I speak.

sentences.ar: وأدير، بليلة موته، كان قاعد بيعد المصاري، عشان يرجعها للي غشوهم.
sentences.en: And Adair, on the night of his death, was sitting counting the money, to return it to those they had cheated.

sentences.ar: وقفل الباب عشان أهله ما يشوفوه.
sentences.en: And locked the door so his family would not see.
And Moran shot him from across the street.

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: وهلق، موران عارف إني رجعت.
sentences.en: Holmes said: and now, Moran knows I am back.

sentences.ar: شافني اليوم بالشارع، وأنا العجوز، وما عرفني.
sentences.en: He saw me today in the street, as the old man, and did not know me.

sentences.ar: بس بعد ساعة، حدا شافني بايكر ستريت.
sentences.en: But an hour later, someone saw me in Baker Street.

sentences.ar: وموران رح يجي الليلة، عشان يقتلني.
sentences.en: And Moran comes tonight, to kill me.
From across the street, with the air-gun.
And we will be waiting for him.
I said: where?
He said: in the empty house.
Opposite mine.
